subject: SignalWave renewal & expansion — tiered step-up + routing add
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martín <elena@signalwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M for renewal/expansion

Hi Elena —

Great to connect this morning. Quick recap and two asks so we can land a firm quote and rollout plan: 

What we covered
- Current usage: ~120M prompt+completion tokens / month (production routing to small and medium LLMs).
- Growth plan: pilot upgrade adds new ingestion route for classification and a higher-capacity model for summaries (you estimated 400–700M tokens/mo in 6–12 months depending on adoption).
- Renewal timing: current term ends end of Q1 2027; interested in a 12-month reserved commit to get predictable unit economics.

Two asks (please reply inline):
1) Confirm the 12-mo commit window you prefer (start date options: 2027-01-01 or 2027-02-01).
2) Share your target unit economics: what is your target $ per 1M tokens for (a) standard routes / small models and (b) large/summary model routes? If you have a blended target for a combined commit, include that.

Why this matters
- If SignalWave commits to a stepped capacity (e.g., 250M -> 500M -> 1B tokens by month 12) we can propose a blended tier that materially reduces $/1M while keeping fallbacks for latency-sensitive routes. We need the target to model the blended quote and reserved discount.

Attached: a CSV I pulled from our notes to match quantities to the different route types (signalwave-mau-estimate.csv).

Next steps we propose after your reply:
- I’ll circulate a 2-tier and 3-tier blended quote (includes per-model route pricing and reserve discounts)
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up to review SLA, routing behavior, and rollout calendar (I’ll propose slots).

Thanks — enjoyed the conversation,

Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: signalwave-mau-estimate.csv (CSV, 1.2 KB)
From: Elena Martín <elena@signalwave.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@signalwave.ai>, procurement@signalwave.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M for renewal/expansion

Priyom — thanks for the summary. Quick answers inline below.

1) Commit window: we prefer a 2027-02-01 start (aligns with our fiscal planning).
2) Target $/1M tokens:
   - Standard/light routes (chat assistants, low-context Q&A): target ~ $9–11 / 1M tokens.
   - Heavy/large-summary routes (long-context summaries, multi-turn transforms): target ~ $18–22 / 1M tokens.
   - If you can give a blended all-in at ~ $12 / 1M for a combined 500M+ commit, that would be compelling to procurement.

More context:
- Current baseline: 120M/mo today, but expected to spend ramp capex for the next 6–9 months as we onboard new customers.
- We will likely add a new model route for high-precision summarization (estimated 200–300M tokens/mo after full rollout).
- Procurement needs a 12-month service-level summary and a sample SOW/DocuSign-ready quote.

Also please include options where we keep a small burst pool for peak traffic vs strict throttle (we prefer burst to dropped requests).

Elena
Head of Product, SignalWave
elena@signalwave.ai

On 2026-11-22 09:12, Priyom Das wrote:
> Great to connect this morning. Quick recap and two asks so we can land a firm quote and rollout plan...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martín <elena@signalwave.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: SignalWave — preliminary blended scenarios & pricing math

Elena / Priyom — looping in a pricing lead to put concrete numbers against the targets you listed. Below are two scenarios (conservative and aggressive) that map to the traffic shapes you described.

Assumptions (please confirm):
- Start date: 2027-02-01
- Baseline current usage: 120M tokens/mo
- Ramp to committed: Scenario A = 500M avg / mo (steady), Scenario B = 800M avg / mo by month 12.
- Routes: 70% standard routes, 30% large-summary routes (per Elena’s note).

Scenario A — 12-mo reserved commit (500M avg)- Base unit list prices (unreserved): standard $22/1M, large $40/1M- Reserved blended proposal: standard $9.50/1M, large $18.50/1M- Weighted blended rate (70/30): (0.7*9.5 + 0.3*18.5) = $11.65 / 1M- If SignalWave commits to an accelerated step (250M for months 1–3, 500M months 4–12) we can add a 5% additional volume discount -> blended ~ $11.07 / 1M

Scenario B — 12-mo reserved commit (800M avg)- Reserved blended proposal: standard $8.50/1M, large $17.00/1M- Weighted blended rate (70/30): $10.15 / 1M- Includes 10% reserved capacity discount vs Scenario A numbers.

Notes on routing & burst pool:
- We’ll propose a dedicated burst pool that is metered but billed separately at a slightly higher unit ($/1M) only when used; this keeps production latency unaffected.
- If you want per-route SLAs (e.g., p95 latency for standard routes), we can price those as add-ons or bake them into the reserved price with a small premium.

Attached is a clean PDF with the above math and a 3-tier alternate (100/300/800) for completeness: proposed-tiered-quote.pdf

If these look directionally correct, Priyom and I will convert the preferred scenario into an SOW and a DocuSign-ready quote (with clear breakpoints and overage terms).

Action items:
- Elena: confirm preferred scenario (A or B) and whether procurement needs net-30 or net-45 payment terms.
- We: produce SOW + DocuSign and schedule a 30-minute handoff with procurement.

Ben Carter
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed-tiered-quote.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
From: Elena Martín <elena@signalwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@signalwave.ai, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@signalwave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SignalWave — preliminary blended scenarios & pricing math

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and very close to what procurement requires.

We’ll go with Scenario A (500M avg) with the accelerated step-up (250M months 1–3, 500M months 4–12) and the additional 5% step-up discount you noted. Procurement prefers net-30.

Next asks before we sign:
- Please send a DocuSign-ready quote + SOW that reflects the blended rate after the extra step-up discount (please show both per-route unit prices and the single blended $/1M).
- Include a short clause for a reserved burst pool (250% of committed peak) with a metered overage rate.

If you can get the SOW and DocuSign link to procurement this week we’ll move quickly — Carlos will be the procurement owner on our side.

I’ll accept a calendar invite for a 30-min review on Friday if you have availability.

Best,
Elena Martín
Head of Product | SignalWave
elena@signalwave.ai
